datasets.title: Philippines: 2024 Tropical Cyclone Tracks
datasets.description: Tracks of Tropical Cyclones that entered the Philippine Area of Responsibility in 2024. Observed positions were provided by DOST-PAGASA. (https://www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph/). [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-2024-tropical-cyclone-tracks]

entity.name: DOST-PAGASA (Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration)

lineage.description: Tropical cyclone track data was compiled from direct observational records provided by DOST-PAGASA, capturing the positions (begin/end timestamps), names, and intensity categories of all tropical cyclones entering the Philippine Area of Responsibility in 2024. The tracks were digitized as vector line geometries and published in GeoJSON and GeoPackage formats for use in disaster risk and preparedness applications.

sources.name: DOST-PAGASA (Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration)
sources.description: DOST-PAGASA provided the observed positions and category classifications of tropical cyclones entering the Philippine Area of Responsibility in 2024. This constitutes the primary observational source for the cyclone track geometries and attributes.
